trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (weighted w=w1, essentially near-uniform weights) and the verdict is "indistinguishable" from the runner-up. With only 3 validation windows, unstable ranking (Kendall tau -0.185), and 8 correlated-error groups, fitted weights carry high variance. The diagnosis explicitly hints "robust," and the near-uniform weighted mean already captures that. Accepting is the right call.

action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (slope agreement 0.915) and strong seasonality (period 52), but the model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau -0.185) and 8 of 19 models fall into correlated-error groups, leaving only 5 independent error sources. With so few windows, fitted weights are high-variance and the near-uniform weighted combination (w1, concentration 0.0) is the robust choice. The leader and runner-up are statistically indistinguishable (margin 0.00016), confirming that no subset or re-weighting can reliably separate them on this series.
